hints.title: Preserving Outer Group Aggregation
hints.text: Tally enrolled members across faculties, ensuring units without any registered members remain represented with zero.

hints.title: Left Outer Join and Null Count
hints.text: Left join departments to students and count student identifiers rather than wildcard rows so that unmatched departments produce zero.

hints.title: Department Count Blueprint
hints.text: Left join Department d with Student s on d.dept_id = s.dept_id, group by d.dept_id and d.dept_name, order by student_number descending, dept_name ascending.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    d.dept_name,
    COUNT(s.student_id) AS student_number
FROM Department d
LEFT JOIN Student s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name
ORDER BY student_number DESC, d.dept_name ASC;
```

variables: N: total number of department and student records
complexity.notes: Left outer join and composite ordering evaluate in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inner join excludes departments having zero enrolled students.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Outer join maintains complete coverage of all defined departments.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of LEFT JOIN and COUNT(column) instead of COUNT(*) to preserve zero for nulls.
